title: Personal Checking: Dormancy, the Dormant Account Fee and Reactivation
content:
## What keeps an account awake

For Personal Checking, customer-initiated activity is a deposit or a debit that the owner sets in motion — at a branch or an ATM, with the debit card, through a paid check, a mobile deposit, an online transfer, Zelle, a wire, or an ACH debit the owner authorized. Entries that arrive without the owner acting — interest, fees and their refunds, direct deposits and any other ACH money coming in — are left out. The account record keeps the posting date of the most recent customer-initiated activity.

## Becoming dormant

An active account is classed as dormant once the tier's inactivity period, in calendar months, has run from that date. The months are counted from the date of the last customer-initiated activity; the account is due for dormancy on any date on or after that date moved forward by the tier's number of months, and when the resulting month lacks that day, its last day is used.

## While dormant

- At each statement cycle close the tier's dormant account fee is booked as a dormant account fee entry. It is trimmed so the balance stops at zero rather than going negative, and nothing is booked when the balance is already zero or less.
- Interest crediting and the posting of incoming credits continue as usual.

## Reactivation

Two things together wake a dormant account: the owner's identity is confirmed in the contact now under way, and the owner goes on to make a transaction. The verification must be on the verification record before the account is reactivated; the owner's word alone does not suffice. The date of that reactivating transaction becomes the new date of last customer-initiated activity.

## Worked points (hypothetical)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Last customer activity on the 31st of a month, inactivity period ending in a 30-day month | due for dormancy on the 30th, that month's last day |
| Dormant account with a balance of 3.20 USD, on a tier whose dormant fee is larger | fee trimmed to 3.20 USD, leaving zero |
| Dormant account with a balance of 0.00 USD | no dormant fee entry |
| Only a direct deposit posted in the last year | not customer-initiated; the inactivity count is unaffected |
| Owner verified in this call and makes a transfer | reactivated; that date becomes the new activity date |
